seriesTitle: Tell Me That You Love Me

episodes.title: Ep 01 Greet
episodes.summary: Jinwoo and Moeun cross paths in Jeju. She gets upset because he keeps ignoring her.

episodes.title: Ep 02 Chord
episodes.summary: Jinwoo and Moeun meet again in Seoul and try to get to know each other better, but it's not easy.

episodes.title: Ep 03 Tears
episodes.summary: Jinwoo and Moeun get closer slowly. But he feels bad for her and tries to keep his distance.

episodes.title: Ep 04 Empathy
episodes.summary: Jinwoo returns after disappears for days. He feels bad that he hasn't stayed by her side.

episodes.title: Ep 05 Regards
episodes.summary: Moeun's play ends well thanks to Jinwoo's support, and her feelings for him get bigger.

episodes.title: Ep 06 Companion
episodes.summary: When Seokyung shows up, Jinwoo feels confused. Moeun just envies Seokyung her fluent sign language.

episodes.title: Ep 07 Beginning
episodes.summary: Jinwoo and Moeun start a happy relationship, and Seokyung makes him an offer.

episodes.title: Ep 08 Influence
episodes.summary: Seokyung suggests Jinwoo should hold an exhibition. Johan realizes his feelings for Moeun.

episodes.title: Ep 09 Reasons
episodes.summary: Jinwoo meets Moeun's parents, and Moeun finds out Jinwoo and Seokyung used to be lovers.

episodes.title: Ep 10 Courage
episodes.summary: Moeun roots for Jinwoo's exhibition, but it bothers her that Seokyung and he meet often.

episodes.title: Ep 11 Desire
episodes.summary: Jinwoo gets arrested just before the exhibition. Moeun happens to see Jinwoo and Seokyung argue.

episodes.title: Ep 12 Secrets
episodes.summary: Because of Jinwoo and Seokyung, Moeun feels down. Meanwhile, Johan comes to hear her secrets.

episodes.title: Ep 13 Confession
episodes.summary: Jinwoo and Moeun try to clear all the misunderstandings, but the conflicts between them deepen.

episodes.title: Ep 14 Reminiscence
episodes.summary: Moeun accidentally sees Seokyung's text messages to Jinwoo. She asks Seokyung to meet her.

episodes.title: Ep 15 Come to an End
episodes.summary: Jinwoo and Moeun feel distant from each other. They try to get close again, but it is not easy.

episodes.title: Ep 16 Sympathy
episodes.summary: Jinwoo and Moeun realize belatedly that they learned true love through their time together.
